intro: A Bottle of Disease is a vial of virulent concoctions brewed by the Forsaken operating in Ashenvale. Found at an encampment near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, these vials represent an ominous attempt by the undead to introduce blighted plagues into the pristine night elven wilderness.

p: Deep within the ancient canopy of eastern Ashenvale, the Forsaken have crept far past the front lines of the Warsong Outriders. Establishing an outpost near the Dor'Danil Barrow Den, undead alchemists brew foul contagions and seal them within glass bottles. To the night elves guarding Forest Song, these vials are clear evidence of a quiet, insidious offensive aimed at sickening the woodland soil and wildlife rather than engaging in open combat.
